text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka,
who pulled off a magnificent victory at the Kinko Sho.

Word of her spectacular feat spread in an instant,
and the next day's press conference was packed with reporters.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm, thank you for having me to—
(Splash-splash-splash—)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You pulled off a fantastic victory yesterday, but is your next target a GⅠ race after all!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You're often called the "Out of this World Escape Artist"—
how do you feel about that title!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Is there anyone you consider your rival!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (I want to get to training right away...!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Interviews are so noisy...
Being out on the track is so much more calming after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's not really pressure, per se.
It's just... I'm not very good at this kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If all we had to do was run, it'd be easy...
Being an Umamusume is tough work, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you never change, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There's something I need to tell you. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Sure, that's fine, but...
Why so formal all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yesterday's "Kinko Sho" was splendid.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
From the moment you enrolled, you were someone
who simply loved running—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you become an Umamusume
who receives such thunderous applause made me so proud.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...The presence you gave off
at the Kinko Sho was truly immense."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit, her obsession with winning.
And above all, her overwhelming strength—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume around you all gasped in unison,
leaning forward as they watched you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—The very existence of Silence Suzuka
gave rise to a new "ideal."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's...

Air Groove raised a hand,
cutting off Silence Suzuka before she could deprecate herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is why... I will surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have to surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... I'm grateful to you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will also be running in the next Grand Prix race, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: See you at the racetrack...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
She firmly grasped the right hand that Air Groove had extended to her.
